segments.name: Software and Services
segments.description: Sells cloud software that captures, stores and analyses video and digital evidence.
segments.evidence: Software and Services: We develop, manufacture and sell cloud-based Software-as-a-Service ("SaaS") solutions that leverage AI and enable our customers to capture, securely store, manage, share and analyze video and other digital evidence.

segments.name: Connected Devices
segments.description: Makes TASER devices, cameras, drones and related hardware for law enforcement.
segments.evidence: Connected Devices: We develop, manufacture and sell fully integrated hardware solutions such as conducted energy devices ("CEDs") sold under the TASER brand, body cameras, fixed and in-car cameras, drone and counter-drone technologies, and a broad ecosystem of accessories, extended warranties and related hardware products.

revenueModel.text: Police agencies and other customers pay for hardware, software subscriptions, services and warranties.
revenueModel.evidence: Our revenue is derived from a combination of hardware sales, multi-year recurring software subscriptions, professional services, and extend ed warranties.

changes.text: Realigned in 2025 from TASER and Software and Sensors into Software and Services and Connected Devices.
changes.evidence: Previously reported within two reportable segments, TASER and Software and Sensors, we realigned our business in a manner that provides increased transparency and distinction between our software and services and hardware components.
